The New Year’s Gift

Robert Herrick (1591–1674)

L
ET
 others look for pearl and gold,
Tissues and tabbies
 manifold:
One only lock of that sweet hay
Whereon the blessèd baby lay,
Or one poor swaddling-clout, shall be
The richest New Year’s gift to me.
